differences.what: massing: the draft's 9 x 5.5 m box with wings under a hip is now the sheet's front block, 7.72 m wide, two storeys of wall under a bracketed cornice with the slated mansard over them; its south corner at x about 240 px against the print's 230, its cornice at y 340-360 against 345-360
the south bay's round-headed light in the second storey under its keyed hood (x 55-150 px), and the principal storey's light under it behind the veranda
the mansard's round-headed dormer over the south bay and the tall stack over the deck behind it
the veranda's height and floor: its flat roof about y 700 px and its floor about y 1115, on open piers to grade, at the print's

the veranda's front run: the print's round columns on panelled pedestals with a turned balustrade between them and a deep plain entablature run across the front and on past the house's south corner to the corner pair at x 515 px; the render lays the entrance kit's square posts across the front only, so the run reads as a beam and a balustrade and the corner is the side porch's

the veranda's south run stands on K01's solid side-porch podium where the print shows its floor on open square piers, and carries a low balustrade on its roof that the print does not show (liberty L-k01-2109-roloson-3666)

the rear block's step south of the front block shows its brick front about 160 px wide beyond the house's corner where the print shows only a narrow strip and its cornice end (x 225-285 px): the step is likely shallower than the 2.32 m read off the sheet's coarse copy, or the camera's distance is off
the dormer's carved, scrolled surround and hood (x 15-160, y 160-340 px) is a plain moulded surround
the frieze's long sunk panel and lozenge and the carved pilaster strip on the front's south corner are not laid; each is under about 0.3 m of relief and depth
the mansard's rise: the render's face stands a little taller than the print's to the deck cornice
colour: the print is monochrome; the stone's pale tone agrees with the render's Lemont limestone, the flanks' brick is unseen
the front north of the south bay, the door, the steps to the veranda, the north flank and the rear: out of the print's frame

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
